principles: Identifier interoperability and result-semantic interoperability are separate problems.
Do not coerce ND to numeric zero.
Do not coerce NOT_PERFORMED to NOT_TESTED.
Do not infer a specific LOD/LOQ interval from a generic source qualifier such as <LOQ.
Preserve source literals, units, limits and assessment separately when the target model cannot express them losslessly.
OpenTHC status values combine concerns that WeedDAO keeps separate: analytical state and assessment.

mappings.guidance: Map a WeedDAO numeric measurement to qom/uom when exactly one target measurement is selected. Keep assessment separate during transformation.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC Lab_Result_Metric defines qom as Quantity of Measure and uom as Unit of Measure.

mappings.guidance: status=nd can represent WeedDAO not_detected. Do not create qom=0. Preserve WeedDAO reported_as externally if round-trip fidelity is required.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC Lab_Result_Metric status enum includes nd; OpenTHC example data uses status=nd.

mappings.direction_note: The OpenTHC concept is more specific than the WeedDAO generic below_reporting_limit state.
mappings.guidance: Use only when the source establishes below LOD. A generic <LOQ value is insufficient.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC lab-metric-qom.yaml defines LT-LOD as Less Than Level of Detection.

mappings.direction_note: The OpenTHC concept asserts a specific interval that WeedDAO below_reporting_limit alone does not.
mappings.guidance: Use only when evidence establishes greater than LOD and below LOQ. Never infer this interval from the literal <LOQ alone.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC lab-metric-qom.yaml defines GT-LOD / LT-LOQ as trace amounts between LOD and LOQ-LB.

mappings.guidance: Map only when the source meaning is Not Tested.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC Lab_Result_Metric status enum includes nt; lab-metric-qom.yaml separately defines N/T as Not Tested.

mappings.guidance: N/T is directly compatible with WeedDAO not_tested.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC lab-metric-qom.yaml names N/T Not Tested.

mappings.guidance: Do not map to nt unless the source explicitly means Not Tested. Preserve not_performed in an extension or leave unmapped.
mappings.evidence: No distinct Not Performed value was identified in the reviewed OpenTHC result schema or special-qom list.

mappings.guidance: The published enum exposes nr but the reviewed schema does not expand its meaning. Treat nr as a candidate mapping only after implementation/source semantics establish Not Reported.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC Lab_Result_Metric status enum includes nr without an expanded definition in the reviewed schema.

mappings.guidance: Map when na is established as Not Applicable by implementation context.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC status enum includes na; its special-qom list explicitly defines N/A as Not Applicable.

mappings.guidance: N/A is compatible with WeedDAO not_applicable.
mappings.evidence: OpenTHC lab-metric-qom.yaml names N/A Not Applicable.

mappings.guidance: Preserve as an extension or source-native field. Do not map to nr without evidence.
Do not invent a target status. Preserve the unknown state outside the core OpenTHC fields.
Direct for a selected single measurement, subject to unit compatibility.

mappings.direction_note: WeedDAO permits extensible units and multiple concurrent measurements; the reviewed OpenTHC schema documents a narrower uom enum.
mappings.guidance: Do not silently normalize or discard source units. The OpenTHC example data also contains uom values outside the published enum, so validate implementation behavior before transformation.
Map numeric LOD with the applicable unit.
Map numeric LOQ with the applicable unit.

OpenTHC limit is described generically as an upper limit below which a sample passes. It does not preserve WeedDAO's limit type distinctions. Map only with explicit context and retain the original limit type externally.
Pass assessment can map to status=pass, but WeedDAO separately preserves analytical result_state. Round-trip conversion cannot assume status=pass means detected.
Fail assessment can map to status=fail, but preserve WeedDAO result_state and all measurements outside the compact status.
No raw source-literal field was identified in the reviewed Lab_Result_Metric schema. Retain reported_as in an extension for round-trip fidelity.
Do not arbitrarily select one unit for archival conversion. A target implementation needs repeated metrics or an extension if it must preserve all reported units.
OpenTHC special qom concepts can encode some directional meaning, but they are not a general numeric comparison-operator field.
No explicit report-only marker was identified in the reviewed OpenTHC Lab_Result_Metric model. Preserve report-only requirements in rule/context metadata rather than fabricating pass/fail.

corpus_tests.weeddao_to_openthc: status=nd is compatible; reported_as is not represented in the reviewed target core.
corpus_tests.openthc_to_weeddao: status=nd can become result_state=not_detected; do not synthesize a numeric zero.
corpus_tests.loss: source literal may be lost unless retained as extension

corpus_tests.weeddao_to_openthc: No safe automatic special-qom selection because <LOQ does not prove whether the value is below LOD or between LOD and LOQ.
corpus_tests.openthc_to_weeddao: LT-LOD and GT-LOD/LT-LOQ can both map to below_reporting_limit while preserving their literal/specific threshold context.
corpus_tests.loss: OpenTHC-specific interval precision is lost if converted to the generic WeedDAO state without reported_as/limits; WeedDAO source literal is lost in the target core in the other direction

corpus_tests.weeddao_to_openthc: No exact mapping identified. status=nt/N/T means Not Tested and must not be substituted automatically.

corpus_tests.weeddao_example: cannabinoid results preserve both % and mg/g measurements
corpus_tests.weeddao_to_openthc: Reviewed target core exposes one qom/uom pair per metric.
corpus_tests.loss: one representation must be dropped or an extension/repeated target metric is required

corpus_tests.feature: numeric result plus FAIL assessment plus four concurrent units
corpus_tests.weeddao_example: total_thc result_state=detected, assessment=fail, measurements in %, mg/g, mg/serving and mg/package
corpus_tests.weeddao_to_openthc: status=fail preserves the assessment signal but not the independent detected state or all four measurements in one core metric.
corpus_tests.loss: separation of analytical state from assessment and multi-unit fidelity

conclusion.next_action: Validate these semantics with an external OpenTHC/WCIA implementer or real customer export before adding transformation logic.
